doc.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Upcoming tour and plan to write vocalese to Miles Davis's 'Round Midnight
summary: Plans for a European tour and an album lyricizing the Miles Davis album; he does not play piano.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What a wonderful — What’s in the immediate future for you? European tour?

Well I’m going on this tour. I’m getting together another album and I’m going to do a vocalese project. I’m going to lyricize and sing the Miles Davis “‘Round About Midnight” album. Yeah. That’s going to be a labor of love. I love that album. I think it’s the best jazz album I’ve heard since Bird and Diz.
Do you work at the piano when you do this?
No. I don’t know how to play.
